verdict.rationale: Ghostty ships an official first-party CLI: config keys work as launch flags, `+show-config` prints defaults and docs, and a hands-on probe confirmed `+list-actions` and `+help`. That same probe found no remote-control or IPC interface, so an external script or agent cannot send commands to or read output from a running instance, which limits agentic use. missing for 10: CLI remote control/IPC of running instances, agent-oriented CLI commands (sending input, reading output), dedicated CLI reference documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Every configuration key is a valid CLI flag when launching Ghostty from the command-line.
In the CLI, you can run `ghostty +show-config --default --docs`.
`ghostty +list-actions` enumerates 85 bindable actions (new_split, new_tab, ...) and `ghostty +help` documents the +action CLI surface
